views.front:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original Crownforge Thorn Spear modular character cutout atlas for smooth skeletal animation.
Input images: Reference1 is the old Thorn Spear and defines ONLY his identity/costume; reference2 defines the required 16-component modular layout and realistic quality, NOT that woman's identity.
Primary request: Rebuild the fur-and-bone armored male Thorn Spear as refined, believable premium 3D-rendered historical-fantasy game art. Create exactly SIXTEEN separate complete character parts, ONE part in each cell of a FOUR-COLUMN by FOUR-ROW grid. This is a parts library, never a complete figure, poses or repeated whole characters.
Identity: robust athletic adult man, warm medium-brown skin, angular face and strong jaw, dark brows, clean-shaven, long black hair gathered into a high topknot with a long tied ponytail. A few small bone beads and muted red ties decorate the hair. NO helmet. Weathered brown leather chest armor and hide layers with an ivory animal-tooth necklace across the upper chest, fur accents, crossed deep-rust-red cloth chest straps, rough hide waist panels with red ties, fitted dark-brown trousers, leather arm bracers, leather knee protection, cream-fur-edged lower-leg wraps and dark-brown practical laced boots. Separate upper arms include muscular skin and small asymmetric bone/hide shoulder guards. Preserve this specific warrior's costume and silhouette. Natural realistic anatomy and painterly premium sculpted materials: worn leather grain, soft fur, subtle bone patina, cloth stitching, natural skin, no thick outline. Warm upper-left light and soft cool fill.
Required exact component order, no labels or drawn grid:
Row1: (1) head and short neck including topknot but NO long tail; (2) sleeveless torso from neck to belt with leather/hide chest and red crossing straps, NO head, arms, shoulder caps, ponytail or shield; (3) separate belt/hip hide skirt from waist to above knees with red ties, NO legs; (4) one separate LONG BLACK TIED PONYTAIL from attachment at top to tips at bottom, tied with red cord and tiny bone beads, no head behind it.
Row2: (1) anatomical LEFT upper arm from shoulder TOP to elbow BOTTOM with its small hide/bone shoulder cap; (2) anatomical RIGHT upper arm shoulder TOP elbow BOTTOM; (3) LEFT forearm with leather bracer elbow TOP wrist BOTTOM, NO hand; (4) RIGHT forearm with leather bracer elbow TOP wrist BOTTOM, NO hand.
Row3: (1) LEFT tightly curled empty gripping hand with short wrist at TOP and folded fingers below; (2) RIGHT tightly curled empty gripping hand; (3) ONE LEFT thigh hip TOP knee BOTTOM, fitted trousers and leather knee guard; (4) ONE RIGHT thigh. Each thigh cell has exactly one single leg segment, NEVER shorts or paired legs.
Row4: (1) LEFT lower leg knee TOP ankle BOTTOM with brown wraps and cream fur edging, NO foot; (2) RIGHT lower leg, NO foot; (3) LEFT boot alone ankle opening TOP; (4) RIGHT boot alone.
Construction: every limb's joint-center axis hangs vertically down in a neutral straight relaxed position. The torso sides are CLOSED CONTINUOUS LEATHER AND HIDE PANELS: no circular hole, no black hollow socket, no baked bare shoulder or upper arm. Arms separately overlap this continuous torso. Hands have four fingers folded into a compact natural gripping fist around an empty narrow handle-shaped space; never splayed, no open bowl palm, no flat hands. The fingers and thumb should clearly enclose a small visible empty grip space. Keep cuffs short so wrist-to-grip anatomy is easy to rig. Every piece has generous transparent padding; no touching or clipped pieces.
Critical exclusions: NO spear, weapon, shield, round back shield, arrows, held object, rope weapon, baked equipment, whole body, floor, scene, labels, captions, numbers, grid lines or cast shadow discs. Shield will be rendered separately in the game.
Background: actual transparent RGBA PNG, all empty spaces alpha zero, no painted checkerboard or opaque backdrop. All16 complete separate pieces sharp and fully in frame.
View: true FRONT, facing the viewer with modest orthographic 15-degree elevation. Show front facial features, chest straps and necklace, front hide skirt, knees and toes. Every part is front-facing. Anatomical left means his left, the viewer's right when assembled. Correct separate left/right curled fists with different thumb sides. Ponytail component is its front-facing inner surface.
